cases.description: A CommonJS package finds nested and hidden workspace manifests through readdirSync, then publishes an exact package index.
A scoped ESM package reexports recursive Promise discovery; the app uses lexical Dirent parent paths to read Unicode data files.
A callback-style package discovers nested templates and writes every rendered output before reporting successful build completion.
A promisified callback package sees both a real directory and its symlink alias while keeping typed basenames and lexical parents.
A package refuses to publish a partial scan on missing-root failure; a later successful Promise scan proves the error does not poison subsequent discovery.
A callback-style package processes workspace manifests from one recursive directory cursor and publishes only after close completes.
An ESM package reexports promisified callback opening; the application mixes callback and Promise reads before closing and publishes no duplicate entries.
An application-level parse failure closes a package-owned callback directory, leaves the published index intact, and permits a subsequent scan.

files.main.cjs:
const fs=require('fs');const scan=require('fixture-safe-cursor');
scan('bad',(error,closed)=>{if(!(error instanceof SyntaxError)||!closed)throw Error('parse failure or cleanup lost');scan('good',(error,closed,names)=>{if(error)throw error;if(!closed)throw Error('cursor not closed');fs.writeFileSync('recovered.txt',names.sort().join('|')+'\n');console.log('CURSOR_RECOVERY_COMPLETE',names.length);});});

cases.description: A callback package stops a recursive cursor at its first directory, closes without entering the subtree, and cannot read again after completion.
